note: KDWP state park on the south shore of Pomona Reservoir, about 1 mi north of K-268 on K-368: a string of loops along the shore - Burning Heart (full hookups, by the entrance), Kansa (pinned, by the marina), Waucondah, Big Bear, Red Oak, Osage, Four Winds and Cedar Wind - plus primitive areas and cabins. --Claude
summary: campitks per-site read today: 50 A W/E/S at Burning Heart, pull-throughs, showers/flush/dump/water, open year round, 2027 holiday 3-night minimum, 14 nights per campground. Fees unchanged (KDWP schedule fits: W/E, full, prime). Waterfront DOWN lakefront -> lakeview (no RV site has open land to the water). Count not written (campitks 142+200 vs KDWP 142+240). No split.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN lakefront -> lakeview, per loop on imagery with campitks coordinates (no campitks site is tagged 'Lakefront'): Kansa point 237-239 (the stored evidence's 'SE loop on the peninsula ... marina below') sit inside the point's own outer gravel loop road, ~25 m from the shore - loop road blocks on-water; Kansa 240-244 face the marina docks (day use); Waucondah 221-230 (non-electric, 32-43 ft) on the north rim are 20-40 m back behind a wooded bank fringe; Red Oak primitive 405-415 on the east peninsula rim, same wooded fringe; Big Bear 322-335 are 30-60 m from the cove with their loop road and trees between. Lake visible from Kansa/Big Bear (campitks 'River/Lake View: Y') - lakeview. Unsure on the Waucondah rim fringe, so down.

SPLIT: not a candidate. The loops run as one chain along the shore off one park road from the single K-368 entrance, 200-400 m apart. Most distinct is Burning Heart (34 full-hookup 50/30/20 sites, 5 pull-through, 60-140 ft, all prime, shower house within 1/4 mile, centroid 38.6542,-95.6034, ~150 m from the west cove and not waterfront, campitks no lake view) on its own spur just inside the entrance, ~0.9 km from Waucondah's electric sites - under the ~1 km line and no entrance of its own. Cedar Wind (east end, 38.6544,-95.5812) is ~1.9 km from Burning Heart but contiguous with Four Winds/Osage.

SITES: not written. Utility count agrees at 142 (campitks description; KDWP areas 37+8+19+10+15+13+20+20 = 142), but primitive does not: campitks '200 non-utility', KDWP areas sum to 240. The old note's 'numerous 50-amp big-rig sites' is fair (81 sites at 50/30/20) but dropped as field-held.
FEES unchanged: stored KDWP schedule (permit $17.75, electric +$11, W/E +$13, full +$15, prime +$2) matches the mix.
PIN 38.6590,-95.5933 is on Kansa (beside site 285), central to the loops - keep.
